They say it covers wifi (I'm sorry but it's 2019 and you can get free wifi at McDonalds), parking (open, unmonitored parking lot I should add), a "welcome beverage" (I understood this to be the tea they have out in the lobby), the Tesla charging stations (to my knowledge, only 1 Tesla owner benefitted from this the entirety of our stay), and water stations around the resort (I won't argue this one for those triple digit hot days in PHX). I'm sure the shuttle and bikes are included in their resort fee as well, but they are limited in number and subject to demand, so you might not even get use out of these amenities. By contrast, we also stayed at Enchantment Resort in Sedona, which is the type of place you expect a "resort fee". This was a pretty but glorified, recently-remodeled hotel, not a resort. Sorry, but your resort fee is BS. And also, as others have stated, it seemed like a weekend hot spot for locals and/or a girl's trip destination, which I imagine would be a good place for either purpose. We were celebrating our 5 year anniversary while making our way through AZ and stayed here longer than we should have planned for. Hopefully this will help someone as they are planning. It's really not a bad stay, but they shouldn't charge a resort fee.

findings.title: Elizabeth P. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Aesthetically, The Scott deserves 5 stars. Its seriously stunning! It is so well decorated, the grounds are beautiful and the rooms are artfully decorated. Unfortunately, a resort needs to be more than just beautiful. For a resort in Scottsdale this visually appealing,  you'd expect the service to be out of this world. My boyfriend and I came to The Scott one weekend to preview some rooms to see if I should celebrate my birthday there one weekend (I read the reviews about the rooms not being the best). We toured the grounds and had a gentleman show us a suite and he was very kind. I voiced some of the concerns I'd read, and he agreed, the pool gets way too crowded but said management doesnt listen to the employees and the concerns they hear. He was right, the pool was PACKED. He was the kindest person we would encounter. The rooms were fun, and we decided to book a room. We go to the front desk, and ask if we could please book a room for another weekend. The woman looks at us and says we can do that online. We ask if she could book it for us since we are standing right there, and she says, "Why? I'm just going to do the exact same thing you'd do online." So off-putting. After once again asking her if she could do it, she relents and books us a room. I was disappointed with that interaction but still looking forward to our stay. The day before our stay, we want to see if we can upgrade to one of the suites we toured. My boyfriend calls, and his call is answered by someone presumably off site. He has no idea what were talking about. He says they dont have a suite like the one we are describing. We say they absolutely do, we've physically been inside it. He puts us on hold a few times, probably to call The Scott himself to check. After a lot of back and forth, he says no suites are available. We decide to call the day of our stay, someone at the resort, to check. We call, and they have no issues understanding us and booking us the suite (which in this case is the room right next door, so it's like 2 rooms, and they unlock the door in between them so you have use of both rooms. Which was another reason the interaction was so confusing the day before. Was the whole hotel booked solid?). We really wanted a suite because you get 8 pool wristbands (yeah you need a wristband to swim at the pool), as opposed to 4 for one room. I was going to have friends over for my birthday, and wanted to make sure they'd have the option to  swim. The Scott does allow people not staying at the hotel to swim at their pools, buying a pass through another company, which is why it's always so packed. It looked like no one even had room to swim, standing room only. So we check in and unpack (no elevators btw if you're on the second floor just fyi!), and go to the desk again to get our pool wristbands. The man at the counter gives us 4, and we ask for the other 4 since we booked a suite. He says that's not the way it goes, its 4 wristbands per booking. At that point we were getting upset- the wristbands were the whole reason we got the suite, and we were told several times it came with 8! He finally rolled his eyes and gave us the other 4 begrudgingly. It was not a fun experience. The pools finally did thin out in the evening. To wrap this up, a resort should yes, be beautiful and inviting, but also have 5 star service, which The Scott falls short of.

findings.title: Robert G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: First time I stayed here and the prices are very reasonable the hotels clean the rooms have everything you need in at the pool service is beyond excellent if they have two pools and it's very nice I would definitely come here again

findings.title: Monica N. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I cannot believe this place doesn't have more 5 star reviews. It is hands down one of my favorite hotels in the Scottsdale area.

findings.title: Stephanie S. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
We stayed here from a Saturday to a Tuesday. The pool was crazy busy when we checked in but much less so on Sunday and even more so in Monday and Tuesday. We got a cabana for Sunday mainly because we wanted shade and a guaranteed seat but it turned out a cabana wasn't necessary. The pool that day was a bit crowded but only until about 11:30/12 when people started checking out. Plenty of seats in the shade as well. Michael helped us that day and was attentive, engaging and professional. The drinks were good, not great, as was the food. We had the Cuban fries (these were good), the Cuban sandwich, really good, and the Benedict, this was just okay. I loved the idea of the plantains replacing the English muffin, but they were really dry. The Helen and Maude cocktail was great, but the mai tai and pina colada were just okay. Beer selection at the pool bar was better than at the restaurant but they stop serving at 5. That all seems more against the restaurant than the hotel, however. 
I give the hotel 4 stars because we paid for an upgraded view of the lagoon which wasn't worth it at all. In fact, if I were to return, which I probably would because this is one of the most beautiful places I've ever stayed, I wouldn't upgrade the room at all. Even if I had a room facing the parking lot there are so many bushes blocking the view that it wouldn't really matter. Additionally, and more importantly, there are so many fabulous places to sit around on the grounds that I never found myself sitting outside on the patio anyway. The other reason I would give it four stars is because of the cleanliness. The room was great but they didn't replace our glasses and coffee mugs, and like other reviewer's had stated, room service trays were in the hallways for more than a day. This to me is completely ridiculous and unnecessary.
Overall, we had a terrific experience. I'm glad that we weren't here over a Friday/Saturday because I'll bet it was totally crazy, but Sunday,Monday and Tuesday were really chill and relaxed and not too busy. Everybody from the hotel desk to the pool service to the shuttle drivers were all super courteous and helpful.

findings.title: Michelle S. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
I stayed here last week with my family. Aesthetically, this hotel is beautiful. The style is perfect and the details are incredible. That is why we chose The Scott to begin with. The online photos do it justice. It is very close to many restaurants, with some a short walking distance! Our room was small. I expected small but maybe not that small. I booked two beds when I reserved the room, yet she put us in one bed. We made it work but just a slight annoyance. We could have gone down to change rooms if we wanted to. We upgraded to a Lagoon Room when we booked our stay, so we'd be close to the hammocks to lay in late at night. It was so nice under the stars! I loved the hotel lobby and the property grounds with all the plants and all of the little details don't go unnoticed. Although it is pretty to look at,  we were justdisappointed with a couple aspects of our stay unfortunately. I wouldn't really in recommend this hotel if you have kids. the main reason being that the staff at the pool are not very friendly or accommodating. We spent a lot of our time at the pool. We were ignored by the pool staff to the point where it was obvious to other people that the pool servers were skipping us when asking if anyone needed a drink or had a food order, etc. Both days we went to the pool, different pool staff blatantly ignored my kids and I. They acted like we didn't exist. Just because I have kids with me, doesn't mean I don't want an alcoholic beverage or a bowl of freaking guacamole (which we never got btw). I let the rudeness go and walked up to the pool bar and ordered a drink. The bartender (She had long blonde hair but don't know her name) was probably the rudest female I've had an encounter with at an hotel. She acted like she was so bothered by having to make my drink. She didn't say a word more than what my total charge was( $15),but her body language said it all. She didn't need to open her mouth for me to feel her vibe and her conceitedness. I gave her $1 tip (for my one drink) and she took it without saying a word! I almost asked for it back. I walked back to my lounge chair to my family and a pool server literally looked me up and down then walked up to the women right next to me to ask if they wanted another drink. I've never been treated like this. My kids were so well behaved,not causing any problems or asking for any special services. We just expected the same service as everyone else!!!
I think if you're on a girls trip or with friends, this hotel is a great choice. Pretty much every other person we saw was on a "girls trip". At the pool, we did notice several men without their pool wristbrands. We figured out they were just hanging with their lady friends at the pool. They weren't even staying at the hotel.this seemed to be a common normal thing. Several young couples were all over each other in the pool. Making out, rubbing each other, stroking the hair, that was inappropriate for my kids to see so I just told them to turn the other way which was fine . Multiple groups of women asked me to take their photo. That's one thing you'll notice here is the unusually high amount of people taking selfies on the property. Every turn you make is another person snapping pics. It is actually awkward, the amount of times I had to wait for people to finish their shot before I could walk by. I just stand there oddly staring at how she's positioned at the camera. 
To sum this up, if you're on a girls trip and you are kidless, you'll have a blast. If not, just lower your expectations and be prep for rude blondes at the bar that think you work for them not the other way around.
I will return here sometime, and since I've learned that the Scott is the place for girls trips/wknds, I will make sure that I'll bring my girlfriends!!  So we will be one of those girls on a "girls trip"! Lol. No kids allowed. I'm curious to see how different my treatment will be. I'm sure the room and everything else will be fabulous. Pool staff better step up their game.

findings.title: Ashleigh P. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
This is my favorite secret resort spot in Scottsdale ! 

Walking distance to Fashion square , restaurants, & night life .

I love the decor of this resort 

Great summer rates too!!

findings.title: Dawn M. (2/5)
findings.snippet: My husband and I spent one night here in hopes of a relaxing weekend by the pool and it was unfortunately anything but. The property itself is beautiful with a tropical feel (boutique, not what I consider a resort), the rooms spacious with a nice french door balcony (ours unfortunately was overlooking the parking lot and side street), and the staff is the best part (all that we encountered were extremely friendly and accommodating)...the pool situation ruined it for us however. We arrived around 1pm and both pools were completely packed (people laying on concrete and sitting around the pool edge just for a spot packed), we literally sat for over 3 hours outside the pool area waiting for someone to leave so we could grab a chair (watching other actual guests try to do the same). As others have mentioned, the people that actually got to use the pool were not even staying on property ( locals/bachelorette parties more concerned with taking Instagram pics). Very disappointed especially for the price and on top of that a $40 a night "resort fee" for amenities that we couldn't even use.

findings.title: Stella G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Had the most amazing experience here. We hardly left the resort all weekend! The Canal Club is the perfect spot for breakfast, lunch pool side or dinner! We dined here numerous times during our stay and were never disappointed. The service is also the best we've ever experienced. If you're fortunate enough to cross paths with Jason, you're SURE to enjoy your time at the resort. He served us at the pool almost every day during our stay and went out of his way to make sure we were taken care of. Everyone at this resort was super kind and hospitable, but Jason was hands down our favorite! I forgot my brand new sunglasses at the pool on our first day and was convinced that they were long gone, but Jason had found them and turned them in!!! Service aside, the decor is stunning (I need their decorator to re do my home), every corner is instagram worthy (if you're into that) and well kept. My only complaint would be that the restaurant and bar closes pretty early (10 or 11pm), so you definitely have to leave the resort for any night life. We will most definitely be coming back and hope this this spot never loses its charm!

findings.title: Lincoln S. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Hugely surprised The Scott is less than 4 stars on Yelp. They are 5 stars in my book, hands down. 

The Canal Club (their bar onsite near the lobby) is awesome.  Jay, one of the talented bartenders, is super friendly and knowledgeable. 

As a resort, The Scott has everything you need (two pools, hot tub, room service, trendy interior, walking distance to The Fashion Square Mall, and they have Cadillac Escalades that will shuttle you anywhere within a 3-mile radius).

Oh, and we were able to find a nightly rate of just $150/night (in June).

findings.title: Maria A. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
Disappointed for $139 a night it's not worth it
We coulda stayed somewhere else cheaper n nicer since it's summer here in az a lot of hotel have a deals for a staycation. No breakfast included with the stay. No upkeep of the pool in the afternoon see picture. Look for something else
Would not recommend this place

findings.title: Meg C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: From the second my family & I arrived, we were greeted and taken care of by the NICEST staff I have ever experienced. The Scott is the cutest, perfect oasis. I tremendously appreciated how incredible the food & drinks were, as I never felt I had to leave for anything. Big thank you to sweet Michael, who waited on us at the pool for the weekend. Highly recommend this hotel, I feel restored & relaxed!

findings.title: Ivy F. (1/5)
findings.snippet: This is NOT a four star resort! I feel so cheated! I I I had an extremely long day buying a new home in Scottsdale, checked in and took a shower. The shower had NO DOOR!!!! I called the front desk Immediately to see if maybe it was missing. The manager at the front desk named Jorge Nunez told me he was unable to install a door for me... would I like extra towels to mop the floor!?!?  Does this sound like a four star resort to you??? This place was cute at first but now at realize I just payed $200 for a dump! I'd be better off at a best western. Jorge Nunez should NOT be Managing a four star hotel. Whom ever owns this establishment should be embarrassed!!!!

findings.title: Kurt L. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
A beautifully appointed property with spacious, up to date, smartly decorated rooms. The main lobby is gorgeous and definitely feels like you're on a Caribbean isle. The self-described "Cuban" label is a stretch but it definitely places you on some exotic tropical locale. The courtyard is lushly and lavishly landscaped with palm trees, water features, flowers and the focal point of it all is their two excellent pools. 

You will sleep very comfortably on pillow top mattresses of medium firmness. I don't particularly like the very smushy pillows but hey, you find a way to make them work on vacation. I'd like to have more towels in the bathroom but this is also a small matter. And since I'm approaching triviality, couldn't you have more than like six hangars in the closet? Alright enough nit picking. Huge positive for me is the espresso machine. Again, really excellent spacious comfortable rooms. 

Now for service. I wish I could be glowing. My wife and I did receive excellent poolside service from Mike and Sheridan. The restaurant service was mostly good but there did seem to be some communication breaks between the hostess and servers. The bar service was...well they seemed over worked. When the pool bar wasn't quite open yet, bathers were lined up at the lobby bar. I'm sure they didn't plan it that way but the bartenders were definitely not thrilled. And because I'm from San Francisco and our cocktail culture is ridiculous, I think the bar isn't supplied well. You had maybe three gins and I think I saw only two bourbons. Come on. Bourbon is enormous all over the country right now. You should have at least six different labels. I might also recommend some bar training for the servers. A request for a basic cocktail was sometimes repeated back to me like they hadn't heard of it before. 

Geez I'm being picky, right? That shouldn't deter you from staying here for a long weekend to check it out. We had a great time and enjoyed all of the food and drink we could handle. Nice job all.

findings.title: Ceara H. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Upon arrival we were able to have an early check in which was very nice. The hotel is truly beautiful, however the service does not meet the standards expected of such a higher end resort. The best service received would definitely have come from the drivers as they did their best to make our stay accommodating. The first disparity would be the simple fact that there was no complimentary water in the room. Arizona is a place known for high heat temperatures, and this weekend was fairly warm. If you wanted water, you would have to walk to the front desk and fill yourself up with water there. Secondly, the pool was more occupied by outsiders than people actually staying at the resort. In order for them to lower the chances of people getting free access to the pool, they blocked off the bridge, making it harder for people staying there to get to their rooms by having us walk through the pool instead. Third, this was the final blow to our stay when the maid came in to clean the room, later in the day when we got back we noticed 3 items of clothing that we both specifically kicked to the side by the bathroom were no longer there when we came back to our rooms. Yet, everything else on the floor by our beds was untouched. We first figured it could have been an accident that they had mistaken my clothing items for a towel because it was a white two piece. But I had a black dress specifically on that pile as well and all three were missing. As soon as this was realized I immediately called the front desk to inform them. They said they would check "cameras" which there are no cameras in the hallways, and they actually do laundry off site. They called back a few minutes later to say they didn't have any items turned in and that they would check again tomorrow. I never heard back anything, and now feel like they did not care about taking any kind of responsibility. Even if it were a terrible mistake that the maid could have accidentally picked up items that were not belonging to the room. 

This place has a lot of potential to be a great resort. However, customer service is incredibly important and the service here is mediocre. Again, the best thing about this place is the amazing drivers that drive you around any time you need to make a quick stop within close proximity to the resort.

findings.title: MK K. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The hospitality here is great. You're welcomed immediately upon driving up. We were able to check-in early despite it being a holiday weekend (yay)! The lobby is gorgeous, and the grounds are fantastic. The rooms are super spacious and include amenities like nice bath robes. We got a pool view room, and it had a nice little balcony patio. I really enjoyed sitting at the pool, but the service was a little slow (but it was also packed, so that's understandable). There was a snafu with our bill for drinks and snacks at the bar, but they got it fixed very graciously. I also had an outstanding massage at the spa! Overall, I'm super impressed, and I'd definitely come back here. It's a relaxing and lovely place.

findings.title: Caira W. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I spent my birthday here this past Tuesday and I'm very happy that I did, my friends and I had a fabulous time! We were greeted by the complimentary valet host that had a great sense of humor and literally had me smiling before I even walked in the door. There was only one person working the check-in counter (10am) and there was a line so it did take longer than I would have liked but maybe I was just being impatient because I was so excited. However, the Cuban-style decor kept me in awe as I waited. Whoever decorated this place deserves some kind of award, because everything was stunning down to the simplest detail, it was a completely immersive experience just walking in the door. I checked in, paid for my cabana and was comped a couple happy hour drink vouchers for my special day. We headed out to the pool where our cabana was being set up and since the bar didn't open until 11 we decided to tour the property. If you love taking pictures, this is where you want to be! There were so many picture perfect places at this resort, you can take enough photos to supply a few weeks of consistent Instagram posts. There were various settings that were all consistent with the theme. My friend went into complete tourist mode, taking pictures of chairs and trees lol, but I really don't blame her because everything was so aesthetic!! When we returned back to the cabana, there were a couple issues but was so promptly taken care of, it had no hindrance on the rest of the day and actually made the experience better than I could have anticipated.  The poll was not crowded and there were some really beautiful people hanging out poolside which really added to the pleasantry of the atmosphere. The drinks took forever but were so delicious that it was worth the wait. We were throwing them back so in retrospect the wait helped us pace ourselves so we didn't get drunk too fast so not really a complaint. I highly recommend the Fiztcarldo or the mojito, both were so great, we ended up double fisting these and they are even better together lol.. The pool was cold but the jacuzzi was perfect even on a sunny day. The staff was so nice and kind and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect and it was. My friend sent a bouquet of long stem roses and they found their way to my cabana with no issues. I had also booked a massage and facial at La Vidorra Spa and unfortunately my massage therapist hurt her wrist right before it was my turn so I only got to enjoy the facial. The hostess was so calm and soothing which really set the tone upon arrival. She offered my aromatherapy towels and this white ambrosia tea with honey pearls and omg, amazing! My facial tech was Sharon and she was very informative and has very delicate hands which, in my opinion, really made the facial more enjoyable. I got off the table and my face was so hydrated, especially considering I had been drinking for hours beforehand. I really wish I could have had the massage but I guess it wouldn't have been real if everything had been absolutely perfect so maybe another time. We ended up going for another walk and it's almost as if the resort had got even more beautiful somehow, I think we had missed some areas the first time around. By this time we had ran through the appetizers that came with the cabana so I ordered the Scott burger from the restaurant and mind you this was almost a $20 burger and coming from a penny pincher, trust me when I say it was worth every penny! At this time we used our drink vouchers and then took a mini nap poolside on the day bed. We left shortly after. I am very pleased with my time here and especially all the efforts the staff made to make it perfect for my birthday. The pictures were epic and all of my online friends are envious. I would definitely recommend this resort for a good time! Thank you for a perfect day!

findings.title: Erica K. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Beautiful resort! Every part of the hotel is perfectly decorated! All the staff was so kind and professional in every way! We took the complementary shuttle and our driver was awesome and so funny! The only not great part were the beds and pillows. The beds were hard and the pillows killed my neck, which stinks knowing that cause it would make it hard to want to return again but maybe I'll just bring my own pillow next time!

findings.title: Bruce J. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
2.5 stars. My room was ready (early) upon arrival. The bell hop was fantastic. The spa attendant was sweet and knowledgeable. The masseur (gentleman) was probably the best I've ever had! Location is convenient, walkable, in nice weather. That being said. The pool experience was extremely disappointing. Service was non existent, even after requested. Dirty dishes stayed out all day long. (Collecting birds and bugs) After attention was brought to the issue the problem only worsened. For Two.5 days I walked to the Canal Club bar for drinks and service. That team was kind, efficient and made great cocktails. The pool and spa was constantly full of leaves and gunk (which is likely to happen with surrounding greenery and no upkeep) but we actually skipped the spa one evening because it was so dirty-  Locals are able to use the side entrance without a key and utilize amenities, which became a problem Saturday when guests had no where to lounge.  The hotel esthetic is on trend and beautifully done. If I came just for photos it'd be 5 stars. Unfortunately, for me it was more about service and enjoying a getaway.


... in addition! Charges were incorrect at check-out!!

findings.title: Victoria L. (3/5)
findings.snippet: This was a hit and a miss for me. The resort itself is very unique, it's a perfect setting for instagrammable picturesque scenery. The food / drinks are decent and most, if not all rooms, are remodeled. My bathroom was not cleaned prior to me walking in the room (and I checked in 4 hours early), however did not get the room until 15 minutes post allowable check in time, and still managed to get an uncleaned room. Service and cleanliness can be elevated. I had two interactions with the front desk, one was great and the other was not. Not all rooms have a good view. So you either end up with something great to look at or the parking lot. You would probably need to call and request a room with a view if you're expecting one. Beds are comfy, vanity space is non-existent, I found it hard to get ready. Overall, I personally would not stay here again.

findings.title: Debi A. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Nice resort with beautiful grounds.  Giving only 3 stars because they let everybody and their brother come in and use the pool which means the actual paying guests don't have access to the lounge chairs unless you get there way early. Lots of different groups of friends go there just to use the pool which is fine.  But if I'm paying a fairly high price for a resort, I'd like to be able to have somewhere to sit when by the pool.   Or at least notify us that it's an open to the public pool so we can plan accordingly.  Bell staff is awesome. We borrowed the bikes they have on the premises which is also a nice feature.

In regards to hotel's response below, yes the public can and does come in without buying the pass you mention.  You can walk right into the hotel and right into pool gates. No one is monitoring nor do you need a key to get into pool area.  We spoke to two different groups of girls that said they frequently come to your pool because it's easy to get in.

findings.title: Alex T. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Oh boy... this 4 star "resort" was a joke. I stayed here for 5 days (Sun - Thurs) the pool was NEVER once cleaned, tons of leaves and sticks. If you are going here and want to have a nice big pool that they keep clean then DO NOT come here! 

As far as the actually room itself was basic but had what they had said was a "Cuban/traditional " twist. The reason I'm giving 2  is only bc the bed was very comfortable. The room we had no view of anything, we had a patio on the first floor (2 floors only) that has 2 chairs and a tiny stand that lead to a brick wall that surrounds the resort. 

Didn't see many kids here maybe once I saw 2 kids 18 or younger. 

I'm 24 years old this is not the spot for you if your in my age group... great spot as far as location due to it being close to everything. Not worth the money here and don't get much for the money they want per night here. (Pricey). 

They also said they needed a card on file for accidental damages, never told me the amount the hold was for and dude behind desk made it seem they would charge if needed but held $540.00 until the end of my stay. Ok with them doing it but explain this to people.

findings.title: Justine T. (5/5)
findings.snippet: My family and I checked in this hotel upon stumbling upon it on Groupon, the lobby of the hotel was aesthetically pleasing and just gives you boho vibes, everywhere you turn it's something photo worthy. Stayed at this place 2 weeks ago during spring break. Help yourself to some free tea and water upon arrival in the lobby! I did some research and you'll have to reserve to dine in the hotel's restaurant, for other amenities as well, but you'll have to pay for it such as a massage. You can rent one of their bikes and a map will be provided for some routes you could take in the Scottsdale area. Just a few minutes away is the Scottsdale Fashion Square which is convenient for shopping lovers like me, it's a huge mall with great brands! While exploring the hotel with my twin, we saw there was a gym and pool area as well. We got to swim in the pool, it was a huge pool area! We passed by some nice housekeepers and greeted us with a smile. As for the room, it was clean, there are two beds which were really comfortable to lay on and one bathroom with a marble sink. Other amenities were included such as an ironing board, closet, and a hair dryer. We stayed for one night and it was a great experience staying here, I recommend to stay here if you're in the Scottsdale area!

findings.title: Ricky H. (3/5)
findings.snippet: I am a little disappointed with this resort... Rooms some what run down. My mother's room u had to slam the door shut. Pool area. Nice but the service ladies at the pool bar ignored us,  while helping others. I didn't get it. Then they closed out the pool area for a private party and still charging for the resort fee. Totally uncool man. The main bar inside was unfriendly as well. Not all but most . It was odd. They had Drivers that would drive you downtown and they we're all great. I also felt like the balcony doors were easy to break into. Needs an upgrade on the rooms . They charge high rates. I will most likely try another resort out. It was almost a great place. Darn it

findings.title: Bruce R. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Avoid. Terribly overpriced. Shows well in photos but is obviously pretty old. Lots and lots of layers of paint. Room was very average and just not that nice for the price. Service was Fair - not bad but not up to the level you would expect. Dumb stuff like the missing TV remote, forgot to resupply coffee, and provide clean glasses, we were given one washcloth for two people. There was not enough body wash - recycled from another guest? I asked for a toothbrush and I was giving kid's toothbrush and enough toothpaste for one brushing.

findings.title: Nancy D. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
We had a Sunday morning brunch here on the patio the morning after my granddaughter's wedding.  There were about 20 of us and we did not have a reservation, 
however the service was not just slow, it was practically non existent.  There was a bar inside right off the patio, but no bartender and no server assigned to the patio.  The excuse we got for waiting so long was that they were short staffed.  Not my problem!

This is an upscale resort and there is no excuse for this kind of service.  Food and drinks were very good, if you can stand to wait, and wait, for them.

findings.title: Kate R. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Super basic place for people who wish they were rich and instagram famous but aren't. Pool was completely over crowded with drunk people. Couldn't find any open lawn chairs. Saw one girl puke at the pool from being too drunk. Will not be returning

findings.title: Alfonso C. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
We loved their retro-eclectic-tropical decor that immerses you in a luscious green oasis right in the middle of Scottsdale. 

We loved their outdoor classical movie nights and all the vintage items around the rooms that you get to discover and play with. They have real working turntables and lovely vinyl selections to shop se from. Don't worry they also have mp3 speakers too. 

Their restaurant is fantastic! And I will write another review about it. 

Service was impeccable, decor is fun, chic and eclectic, it is clear that upper management is also doing a great job so congratulations!

I definitely recommend this place for families, couples or business meetings alike.

findings.title: Kristina K. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Super friendly hotel with excellent service. I stayed here with my family while they were in town visiting. We had a minor glitch but hole checking in with the room connections, but they were quickly corrected. Our rooms were spacious and simple. There's roomy patios outside the rooms. The backyard grounds are stunning. Fountains, pools, flowers, tables & trees make you instantly feel like you're on vacation. The food and drinks are amazing too. Larger portions to share and super tasty too. I'll be back with some daytime visits for sure.

findings.title: Charlotte B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I literally cannot complain about anything! This resort is top-notch. So chic and hip, but with thoughtful amenities, a caring attentive staff and THE MOST COMFORTABLE beds. The pool was great! It was the perfect temperature and I loved the beach side for my 2 year old to dig in the sand and not have a super deep pool right out of the staring gate. I took so many photos and drank so many delicious mojitos and ate so much yummy food (avocado toast for the win!). I'm already planning my return so I can take advantage of the bikes and easy access to downtown Scottsdale!!! Loved this hotel.

findings.title: Jaime H. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This resort is so cute and trendy! The rooms are really nice and the beds are super comfortable. It's quiet not too many kids (good for couples). I had a prenatal massage with Selena at the spa and OMG she was amazing!! Literally one of the best massages I've ever had, and I get them often. Cannot wait to visit again! Thank you Scott Resort!

findings.title: Kristin G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I am a local and have visited The Scott twice in the last month.  Both times I ate at The Canal Club - once for breakfast and once for dinner.  Both were absolutely outstanding meals.  I walked the property and it has a very relaxing vibe and many areas to hang out and just relax, or play games with friends.  The breakfast meal I had was outstanding.  I shared it with a friend, so we got to try 2 different selections.  When I returned for dinner, my husband and I celebrated our anniversary dinner there.  We had an appetizer, meal and desert and every bite was delectable.  I had a steak and my husband had a seafood meal and we shared both - they were outstanding.  We will definitely return to the restaurant and will likely plan a staycation this summer to enjoy the grounds more.  We highly recommend The Scott and The Canal Club!!

findings.title: Kate G. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
A super stylish retreat with the best decor!  This resort would be perfect if it was not so noisy.

Nights sleep- 3 out of 5 stars
Comfortable beds. I don't know why some reviews mention that the beds are not comfortable and that there is not a comforter.... the beds are so cozy and there is a duvet on top! 

I had a courtyard room and these are over towards the road. If you can choose the pool rooms these would be much quieter. They courtyard rooms are SO loud. The traffic and idling of motorcycles from n Scottsdale road is terrible.

Decor/style- 5 out of 5 stars
I love how this resort is decorated. It's Cuban meets California modern style. So well done and you really feel like you are on vacation when you come here.

The room I had came with a corner sofa and tiny table that was a great nook for working/eating. 

Amenities- 5 out of 5 stars
Gym is nice with standard workout gear. The pool/ hot tub seems fun but I didn't use them. The spa was great! I had an awesome massage that was worth the cost for sure. The on-site bar/restaurant has great Cuban inspired food. The resort has many places you can sit and read or talk which is great when you are traveling alone but don't want to be "alone". It also seems like there are events for guests every night. 

Location- 5 out of 5 stars
Located in the heart of Scottsdale, everything is near by. They have a car that will bring you anywhere within a 3 mile radius.

findings.title: Krista K. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Amazing!!! So incredibly beautiful it was like decor heaven. Loved our hotel room too, they really optimized the space. Also my baby girl couldn't have has a better time at the pool. Will definitely stay again :)

findings.title: Anne H. (3/5)
findings.snippet: Lovely grounds and attractive, spacious bedroom/bathroom/balcony (complete w a Nespresso). It is also conveniently located. I was pleased with the hotel offering given the Hotwire price and timing (March/Spring Training), but would try somewhere else the next time I am in Phoenix. My main complaint would be the noise-level. I was woken up at 4.30 one morning by some returning bachelorettes - and could hear noise from both outdoors and the corridor. Wish the hotel put a sound machine in the room. The service (apart from the prompt, efficient housekeeping) left something to be desired. Numerous people also pay a fee to use the pools without staying at the hotel so the pool/lobby can get busy with non-overnight guests.

findings.title: Janelle N. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Love love this resort!  Just the right mix of chi chi and laid back vibe.  Always a fun place to have a Happy Hour drink or two!  The plantain and black bean appetizer was delicious and very welcome to this glutenfree vegan!

findings.title: Kevin Y. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Extended stay with Friends and Family during Spring Training and crash landing here is not so bad.  Yea, it gets the loud crowd at the Bar that may interrupt your sleep but we're having a great time wondering when we're gonna hit the pool.  Too many choices.  Wonderful local to hit the games and shopping.  And great vibe in attending to the residence.  Hey, I'm sleeping here.

findings.title: Tawnya S. (4/5)
findings.snippet: I moved out of Arizona 4 years ago but recalled the Fire Sky as nice so figured now as The Scott it would be nice too. I have mixed feelings after three nights. Check in person was harried and seemed annoyed but other staff members throughout the weekend were quite nice. The lobby is lovely but seemed designed for Instagram. The room was huge and well appointed but the bathroom requires you dance with the door a bit to close it. Upon checking in we had 700 towels and one washcloth which is no biggie but after the first day of housekeeping no new or additional washcloths appeared which seems odd. Overall it was decent value for the price; I was surprised at how reasonable the price was during spring break and spring training. I think the price point might be why it attracts the Instagram power drinking red lipstick wearing wanna be Kardashians. Great location and easy parking. I might stay here again but I might try something else similarly

findings.title: Carle S. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
We had a fabulous staycation at The Scott. The hotel decor is awesome! There are so many beautiful seating areas throughout the entire property! We had 3 meals at the restaurant and all of them were delicious!!! 

Will, our server, at The Canal Club was extremely attentive! His service couldn't have been better!

We will definitely be visiting this resort again!!

findings.title: William D. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Very nice and cute hotel. Very relaxing with the pools and river areas in the midle, and very quiet. But, it is about a 10 minute walk from amazing restaurants and shops in the downtown district, and a few more minutes puts you in the club scene. It's nice to have a relaxing hotel but still be able to go out at night! Plus, there are a bunch of scooters and bikes to rent if you don't want to walk! 

Overall, relaxing, quiet and refreshing!

findings.title: Lucy W. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Ok 5 stars for the decor of the the resort and the staff. It was wonderful. 


Our issue with this place was more of the crowd it attracts. We spent a lot of time outside of the resort which was ok because it's close to so much but not what we had planned. There were so many large groups of very loud very drunk women and we had many experiences dealing with different groups being obnoxious or just plain rude to us and other guests. This isn't the resorts fault at all..but if you are looking for just an nice resort to relax and have some quiet time this isn't the place. Puke on the sidewalks and ems and police at the room below us because of a drunk lady. Maybe this was a bad weekend to come but it definitely made us not want to stay around the resort unless we were in the room. Unfortunate because this place really is stunning but I wouldn't risk staying here again.

findings.title: Caitlin B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Loved this resort! From the lobby decor, to the spacious rooms, and the heated pools and spa. The customer service is awesome and friendly too!! The Canal Club has amazing breakfast and lunch menus, not to mention delicious drinks. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu. They also have a free shuttle that takes you anywhere within a 3 mile radius for free! This resort is super close to Old Town, Scottsdale Fashion Square, and plenty of shops and restaurants. Can't beat it. Will be coming back and bringing my whole family next time.

findings.title: LeAnne S. (2/5)
findings.snippet: The entry into The Scott is amazing and beautiful! Yet, the facade starts to crack quickly. From the less then friendly front desk lady to the room overlooking the road, we didn't have the best first impression. After advocating for another room, we traded traffic noise for a weird musty smelling room. Oh well.  We just wanted to settle in after a long travel day.  They did comp our steak after it came out well done after asking for medium rare, but at some point you stay and pay for places like The Scott so that you can relax and not always have to ask for things to be done correctly. It only got worse with the laziest housekeeping service I've ever seen. Keep in mind, they took the tip each day, but left the ironing board out, only left one washcloth, never replaced our glasses, never straightened the room and ignored the shaker in the room (provided in every room) that we used and needed cleaning or ever bothered to replace the ice bucket water or tray. The first day they didn't even clean our room until 4pm when we finally asked! Ugh. This continued day after day and at some point I don't want a comped meal, I just want what I paid for... a clean room, attentive staff, good food, and a chance to relax. I'm really not a difficult customer and frequently stay at 4-5 star hotels so I can feel taken care of! Isn't that part of the price and why people go on vacation? The Scott made it all WAY too hard and charged WAY too much.  Never again.

findings.title: Catherine H. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
First, there is no real "bad," here. The theme is a little off for me - it seems like the place is in the middle of transition. The rooms needs some updates (for example the bathroom door was a little scratched up and needs to be refinished) but nothing that really detracted from the experience. 

My daughter and I did a staycation here over summer and really enjoyed the swimming pool options. 

I want to specifically mention how outstanding the service was, though. My daughter got exorcist-style sick in the middle of the night (turns out she has an allergy to sugar substitutes and this is when we found out) and ended up going to the ER. Since the cleaning staff was off during this period of time the night manager sent the world's nicest security guard who helped us clean up, move rooms, and get on our way to the hospital. Since we didn't get back from the hospital until 6:30 AM they let us check out at our leisure. Hospital visit aside it was an excellent experience and we will be going back!

findings.title: R. Kevin R. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Had drinks and appetizers outside. The grounds are beautiful, fire pits were very nice and warm. The best part was my server Luz. She was so nice and was very attentive. I gave 5 stars because of her.

findings.title: Marita K. (3/5)
findings.snippet: The lobby of this hotel is its most stunning feature. Absolutely beautiful. The breakfasts at the Canal Club were overpriced but delicious. The staff was accommodating. The rooms however are not at a resort level. This was such a disappointment for my husband and I since we were here for vacation prior to having a baby. Not one room on the property has a bath tub. The room advertisement boasts "luxury spa amenities" in the bathroom. This is incredibly false advertising. I would not have stayed at this property had I known the bathroom only has a stand up shower with uneven tile that hurt my already sore pregnant feet. We wanted to love our stay here so much but the room made that impossible.

findings.title: Heather S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Just love The Scott. So many nice things to say...breathtaking scenery, friendly staff, great service. My wife and I were married here almost two years ago and we went back in Oct 2018 for our anniversary (pics feature both occasions). It always exceeds our expectations and we find ourselves looking to go back annually. My only suggestion would be to update the restaurant menu more frequently. As I mentioned, we've been going there for the past (almost) three years and the food never changes. The Scott holds a special place in our hearts.

findings.title: Shannon H. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Kristen is a kicka$$ bartender! 
She made our experience at the resort even better. She's a great ambassador for this environment!!

findings.title: Pepper C. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
The best resort/hotel experience I've had in a long time!! No complaints. I spent 6 days at The Scott during the holidays. The ambience, well-appointed decor, excellent food, laid-back vibe and friendly helpful staff was everything you could ask for. I Loved room service breakfast and outdoor areas with fire pit. It was freezing in AZ this holiday! The fire-pits were perfect for a little outdoor time in 40/50 degree weather. 

With its close proximity to shopping, restaurants and beautiful downtown Scottsdale, I will be back as soon as I can. Not to mention the price point. Room with nice balcony and king bed for 6 nights, less than $1200. Amazing. I go to AZ every year and The Scott is the best experience I've ever had in AZ. Thank you for making my trip so effortless.

findings.title: Travis B. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
My wife and I came here as a birthday stay-cation this past weekend. We had been here years before when it was the Firesky. I remember picking this place again because there was an outdoor heated pool. I called the resort a week ago just to ask if they had a heated outdoor pool and was told yes. After we checked in, we put on our swimsuits, headed to the pool. It might be a little heated, but not enough to swim in, even for Az winters. 
A let down, no doubt, but no big deal. We just hung out in the hot tub. But here's the thing that kind of annoyed me about the resort. It's not cheap. That's why we only do these for special occasions. But there were all these little things that a resort that cost this much for one night should be on top of. Soap: give us at least 2 soaps, one for the shower and one to wash our hands with. The room: was huge! The king bed took up a small area and then the rest was just empty. I would propose a small love seat, or 2 chairs and a small table. Something that can be lounged on in the room. The bathroom: we were aware that the hotel had been upgraded, but the bathroom is still just a redecorated motel bathroom: it's small and there is this enormous walk in closet just next to it that only someone staying a week would use. A better conversion would have been to make the bathroom much bigger. The balcony/patio: we could not enjoy it because the chairs and table were covered in dirt. 
They have items for purchase in the mini-bar: their Sedona water costs $7! Other resorts we've stayed give that to you complimentary. And they put a small bottle of red wine off to the side, away from the mini-bar. It gives the impression that it's free...but the menu says 25 bucks so don't forget. 
The bed is wonderful...super comfy and plush. The grounds are beautiful! Lots of little hideaway sitting areas, firepits, and just cozy areas. The lobby is super cool with an updated Cuban theme-games, decor, movies, fireplaces. The Canal Club restaurant served delicious food, although the first 2 drinks we ordered, they were "out" of. Weird.
So in closing, we weren't as impressed as when we stayed here when it was Firesky.

findings.title: Karrie K. (2/5)
findings.snippet: I will start by saying that I come from Vegas, so when I see "resort & spa" I'm expecting posh. When I see 4 star, I expect posh, and then some. If you are the same, this hotel is NOT for you. The door into the hallway (we were in the 500-517) looked like it had been broken into, as the metal on the inside panel was bent backwards from the outside. The patios are not private, and there is no way to turn off the patio light. The bed was very uncomfortable, and it had the added gift of a scorpion that stung me the first night my husband and I stayed there. I would give this a 1 star, but the TV was cool and I could stream Netflix to it. I will not be returning. If you want to stay in Scottsdale and you want a great Resort & Spa, check out the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess.

findings.title: Tiffany U. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
What is there not to love about The Scott? We were instantly charmed by the Cuban-inspired decor from the moment we stepped foot into the resort. 

I did run into a little hiccup when I called in to make a reservation for the suite- I was told that the suite would be under construction that weeken and that my only option would be to book two rooms. However, my friend was able to call the same day to book the suite. 

Either way, I'm glad that they were able to accommodate us!

What we loved:
- Attentive resort staff who always responded efficiently to all of our needs.
- All the cute nooks and spaces that are insta-worthy.
- Spacious pool area with plenty of chairs for lounging.
- Big suite that was perfect for 6 girls.
- Shuttle service that takes guests anywhere within a 3 mile radius (think Camelback and tons of restaurants in the area).
- Affordable prices- even for a long weekend.

What could've improved:
- Better lighting in the rooms would help! It wasn't easy to do our make up in the dark rooms.
- Less closet space, more bathroom space!
- The service at the Canal Club was extremely slow. 

*Special shoutout to the blonde waitress who not only didn't throw us shade for having a photo shoot in the lobby, but actually helped us take some beautiful photos.

I would recommend The Scott to anyone looking for the perfect resort for a girls' trip!

findings.title: Monica J. (1/5)
findings.snippet: I stayed at The Scott per good reviews. The rooms are old and outdated. There was banging sound coming from the air conditioner all night due to their old system. No complimentary coffee in the lobby. No comfortable chair in the room for guests. The grounds are decent but I find this place overpriced. I will not stay there again and I do not recommend!

findings.title: Tom S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The Scott was a beautiful great place.  One of the main reasons was because they have people like Kristin working.   Kristin is a great asset to The Scott resort.  She has a great personality and is a very hard working woman! Thank you to Kristin and The Scott for a great week!

findings.title: Nilam P. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Came here for a conference over the weekend. Really nicely decorated. Outside lounge area is beautiful and there are trees and plants every where. We did not stay in any rooms just in the conference room and lobby area.

findings.title: Kimberly C. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I love everything about this resort. I've hosted two big events here for work. The customer service and support is among the best in the country. From the teams refilling buffets to the event manager and GM, the customer service, friendliness and professionalism is unmatched. It's truly a pleasure to work with their crew. 

I've never had a meal here that wasn't delicious. The chef and his or her team does an outstanding job. Our clients can be particular, and I've never heard a bad word about the food during our events here. This is the only venue I can say that about. 

The update to the rooms is perfect. They are stylish, cozy and so inviting. I only wish I'd had more time to spend relaxing in my room and enjoying the view of the beautiful pools. 

The outdoor space is what really sets The Scott apart. The pools and various ponds are absolutely lovely. There are so many sweet nooks to cozy up in and enjoy the lovely landscape. Whether a pool view, fire pit or two-person swing is your jam, The Scott has the perfect space to settle into. 

Every time I get to visit I feel lucky for having got to spend time here.

findings.title: Anne H. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We enjoyed our stay here! The food was delicious, the rooms were clean and adorable, the staff was very accommodating. They have a texting service where you can reach out to them if you need any assistance. We needed more coffee in our room and after a  text to the front desk, they quickly delivered additional coffee to our room. I would highly recommend this resort .

findings.title: Taylor T. (1/5)
findings.snippet: DO. NOT. STAY. HERE. Worst hotel I've ever stayed at. The staff is extremely rude and not helpful whatsoever. 1 stayed here for my 21st birthday and I've never regretted another decision as much is staying here. The first incident happened when I told him I had a cake and they said it would fit in the freezer in the room. It did not fit in so I called them back and told asked to come pick up the cake and take it to the restaurant freezer. They said word for word " if you want anything done you need to bring it down here yourself." If I am paying over $300 for one night what should I do anything myself(even as small as room service picking up a CAKE from my room?) it's unnecessary???? Things really turned upside down when we came home from a night out at the bars. When we were walking back to our hotel room we weren't exactly whispering but we weren't being obnoxiously loud either. Just an average amount of laughing and talking. They sent someone up to Thales that we were being kicked out of our hotel room and not only that BUT THEY CALLED THE POLICE. (????) and when the police got to our room even they were confused as to why they were called in the first place and THE POLICE TOLD ME TO TAKE LEGAL ACTION AGAINT THE HOTEL FOR THIS. we had no where to stay and were stranded all night. No refund was given and yup you guessed it, when i talked to the manager he LAUGHED in my face when i asked for one. DO. NOT. STAY. HERE.

findings.title: Dana D. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Did my friends bach here...rooms are so cute! You can check in at ten for an extra fee which made it easy to get the room decorated and things ready for the bach. The lobby area is adorable. The pool staff was very nice. I was really impressed and would def stay here again. I even emailed them the day after I left to get my receipt emailed to me and they did it so fast! Overall awesome experience.

findings.title: Terese C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Truly gorgeous hotel and property!! I loved everything about it from the Canal Club bar and restaurant to the pool to the little details on decor in the rooms - everything was perfect! Very trendy/vintage feel everywhere you went! Lots of pool space with great vibe, energy and music, and they even did a tiki night sat with free cocktails and light food for all guests with a DJ that was super fun!! I'd definitely recommend it and will 100% come back!! Great for a wkend away with your love, or a group for a bachelor/bachelorette party too!! Loved this hotel!!

findings.title: Megan M. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Despite some bumps in our stay, I without a doubt give this resort 5 stars. I'm a local and spent a recent weekend on a staycation here. I've stayed at many local resorts and vote this one as my favorite. The decor and charm of this renovated place are unmatched by others in the area. I could have lounged on the lobby couches all day! The outside grounds, pools, and rooms are equally as gorgeous and pleasant. My favorite part about the room was the beautiful beverage cart equipped with bottle opener, gold plated cocktail shaker, and matching ice bucket. The restaurant's food was impeccable and their cocktails were fresh and unique. 

Being an older facility however, mishaps are inevitable. An unexpected pipe leak left us without water for the majority of one day.  It was challenging. But what impressed me was how apologetic and accommodating the employees were. Everyone from the workers digging to find the leak, to housekeepers, to bartenders; they all went above and beyond to make it okay! We were given free alcoholic beverages, free use of the poolside cabanas, resort fees were waived, and they even mailed us a gift card for a free return stay. Recommendations if something like this happens in the future:  portable toilets delivered on site and the general manager should stop in to help with the chaos.  The poor employees really took a beating from not so understanding guests. 

Despite the water leak fiasco, I most definitely plan to return to this relaxing resort.

findings.title: Ivan C. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
This is an older hotel that has been remodeled. The resort is nice and quaint. The staff is extremely helpful and courteous and the facility is very relaxing. It is a hidden gem in Scottsdale, this resort will make you feel like you are in Cuba with the Latin inspired decor and beach like environment in the desert. 

Our second day at the resort a pipe burst and the facility had no water. This was not pleasant for our trip but the staff and manager personally apologized and made sure we were comfortable and professionally taken cared of. Stephen Johnson the general manager apologized for the inconvenience. This was something out of their control yet they took responsibility. 

I will 100% return to this facility and recommend my family and friends to the Scott Resort. Thank you Stephen and all of the staff.

findings.title: Carolyn Y. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
We are so glad we stayed here when we came to Scottsdale! This hotel is immaculate having just undergone a complete renovation. The renovation actually won an award from architectural digest and it's easy to see why. Not even the smallest detail was overlooked.  We were there for a holiday weekend and despite the hotel being 100% booked it didn't feel like we were being bombarded with people.  

This hotel is walking distance from old town, the mall, and some great restaurants, although the one at the hotel is very good. The hotel also has a shuttle that runs on tips and will bring and pick you up anywhere within three miles. 

We also made use of the spa and had great massages. Everything ran on time. The spa was on the smaller side and didn't have a lot of the amenities like a larger spa would have, but the services we received were top notch.

findings.title: Michael F. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I love staycations! I have booked and celebrated poolside at many valley resorts over the years and the Scott is the best! The rooms were adorable with their gold accents . Not to mention very clean, great sized with patios, and the bed was very comfortable. Staff was extremely and even allowed late check out- yesss!!! One of the pools has a sandy bottom, and a DJ at least on the weekend my wife and I stayed. You can rent beach cruisers for when the weather isn't 110+ and you don't die of a heat stroke. Loved every second of my stay and proceeded to kick and scream when we had to leave back to real life!

findings.title: Bekki F. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
My husband and I celebrated our 10 year anniversary at The Scott and it was amazing! The resort is walking distance to everything in Scottsdale yet when you walk through the doors you feel like you are far away from it all relaxing in a chic Cuban resort. The grounds and pool are fabulous and all of the outdoor seating areas offer many little romantic spots to have a cup of coffee or an amazing cocktail from the bar. The staff was phenomenal and went out of their way to ensure everyone is having a great stay. The rooms are gorgeous and super comfy. It was truly a home away from home. The food and coffee was delicious and the unique cocktails at the bar were superb. I took pictures of all the decor so I can dream of redecorating our house someday. 
And if you are traveling with kiddos I know my boys would have loved the sandy beach entrance pool, jacuzzi and the large lawn to play games. 
Oh... and the spa was marvelous. Gracious and accommodating staff especially when we accidentally showed up a half hour late for our appointment. It was the perfect way to kick off our weekend. 
My husband and I highly recommend The Scott Resort to locals and those visiting our beautiful city and state.

findings.title: Liz B. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Kind of disappointing. The photos looked great but the rooms were pretty worn, and not great service. Don't expect service requests or early check in- after calling ahead to put in our request, and arriving about an hour and a half early from a long drive, we were actually not roomed till past the scheduled checkin time. This on a slow weekend too. The afternoon bartender at the lounge was delightful however- I would probably return just for him.

findings.title: Chelsea A. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This place is so beautiful!! I haven't gotten a chance to actually stay here but I hung out and had lunch, and was just amazed with the decor! The chicken sandwich is also very good too ;) It's a nice relaxing vibe so I will be back to hang out at the pool and check out the spa very soon!

findings.title: Nick B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The Spa was fantastic, great messages. The Cuban atmosphere from the plants, trees, and furniture down to the art and board games was impressive. Staff were friendly, the pool had a fun beach area, and the rooms were quaint with a ton of complimentary amenities.

findings.title: Jennifer D. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Beautiful resort! Everyone was very nice and helpful. The rooms have been remodeled and are done very nicely. Each room has Nespresso coffee  makers for your morning coffee. It is nice to sit out on the balcony and enjoy in the morning. They do not have to go cups for coffee or water, which is a quirk if you are on the go or want to go on a walk or out to the pool. There isn't a place to purchase water either so I would suggest bringing your own if you are a big water drinker. The pool is refreshing and has a nice layout. Another suggestion is that the bar is not a non cash bar, so bring your credit card or just charge to your room. It is centrally locates and great for groups to stay.

findings.title: Kristin C. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
This is hands down one of the best hotels for those who love trendy vibes and friendly staff- and a peaceful sanctuary!! It's Easy to see how gorgeous the place is, so I will skip over that and tell you how warm, welcoming and helpful everyone has been!

I've also been here during construction phases and it honestly has Never been an issue. They are up front about it and make accommodations for your preferences around it as best they can. They treated my family well when they stayed here and their prices so far are very fair (considering season/construction). 

You will not be disappointed staying here

findings.title: Tina M. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Stayed for 2 nights on a girls trip. All in all a great time. The complementary car service is a huge help and the bartenders Will and Benny made delicious cocktails.

findings.title: Austin B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Great vibe at The Scott. We enjoyed staying here and hanging out. The cocktails and food at The Canal Club are to be desired from this boutique hotel. I am excited to come back once the construction is completed to see the final product.

findings.title: Courtney C. (4/5)
findings.snippet: I brought my friend here so we could lounge by the pool for a day/night. Unfortunately, a monsoon caused a big tree to end up in the pool and they had to use a loud chainsaw to get it out. We went to the front desk and they offered us a shuttle to another resorts pool for free. It was so nice. It is such a clean and friendly atmosphere and the decor is so cute. The pool is a little small but other than that we loved it.

findings.title: Shandi G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Beautiful decor and friendly staff. The Tiki party by the pool made me feel like I was in the tropics.  The rooms are newly renovated and are very pretty. I will definitely be staying here again.

findings.title: Tiffani J. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Stayed at the Scott last night for a girls staycation and it was a blast!! The staff was more than accommodating and friendly. The pool was nice and cool and lots of fans with misters.  Then we went down to the tiki party and what a great atmosphere! Fire dancer, good drinks and food!! The rooms are being renovated and really cute!! Definitely will be back !! #thescottsummer18 #scottresort #tikiparty

findings.title: Tyler H. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
**review is for restaurant and over all decor- We are locals so we didn't actually stay here** 

The first impression was over all great. Upon entering the resort we were met with an incredible interior design that would make any instagramer faint. The entire place inside was so photogenic it almost seemed surreal.

Our goal was mostly to try the breakfast at 'Canal Club' (inside the resort) which has been plastered all over social media as the hottest new place to dine for breakfast and brunch in the central scottsdale area.

Once we made our way into 'Canal Club' we were greeted by an extremely friendly host who sat us right away with a smile and down to earth small talk. 

After ordering, The food came out relatively quick- but was disappointingly luke warm and bland. Don't get us wrong, it was pretty to look at, but highly one-note, bland, and left us wanting more. 

It also didn't help that our server, who was friendly, completely forgot about us about halfway through our meal. (this was most likely because a TV show featuring the WWE "Bella Twins" was shooting a scene at the bar. Of course the entire staff went over to take pictures while this was ongoing)

TL;DR: Incredible interior design, friendly staff, but bland food and distracted servers that took way to long.

findings.title: Daniel M. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Easily one of the worst days I've ever had at a resort. Was there for a bachelorette party book 7 different rooms. When we arrived at the property it was under remodel which we were never told about before we got there. I was put in a building where they were remodeling some of the rooms and had one of the entryways into the building blocked off. Started construction at 9 in the morning easily could hear the construction throughout the whole building. Then had so many issues with the third party vendor that I booked through the front desk was not very helpful told me that I was all set and taken care of but then continue to charge me. Couldn't connect to the Wi-Fi and was told that that's an ongoing problem for the Resort and I should try to go to espn.com to see if that would trigger the login page. Attempted to spend Saturday at the pool where the bartender was not only rude but very disrespectful to my friend.Went to dinner at the restaurant on property was put in a nice little blocked-off section for The Bachelorette dinner that was 90 something degrees when we asked for a fan the waitress was rude and told us that they didn't have a fan that they could put it there for us but where we were sitting we could see in the kitchen and see what that one was easily accessible and not being used. Was told I would not be charged Resort fees when I checked out I was charged Resort fees called and spoke to accounting department the accounting department said that they were refunding my Resort fees yet I am still being charged. Would not recommend staying here at all I would strongly suggest staying at a different Resort in the Scottsdale area.

findings.title: Susan M. (1/5)
findings.snippet: The Scott Resort cancelled my reservations 2 days before I arrived.  I made my reservation 9 weeks in advance and the Scott resort cancelled it due to overbooking.  It seems after I booked, they booked in a convention and felt they were more important than me.   I talked to Allyssa, she apologized and offered up their sister property many miles away. I booked that property for the location so that was not an option.  Funny thing was we popped in the bar why we were there and were again ignored.  I would never stay at this property.  We ended up staying at the Doubletree Resort which was fantastic, a blessing in disguise.  The scott feels it's appropriate to charge 40 bucks a day resort fee.  The Doubletree doesn't even have one.

findings.title: Aaron F. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Talk about a staycation resort. This hotel is a boutique as it gets. No waffles being cooked in the lobby all morning, it wraps you in elegance and sophistication. Break away form the big chains and try the Scott Resort today.

findings.title: Janet R. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
Excellent service and super inviting lobby. Lobby and much of common area have been upgraded. Rooms in the midst of same which is great as while not uncomfortable at all, could use a little sprucing up. 
Fabulous customer service! Staff could not be nicer and more accommodating!

findings.title: Diana S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: By far my favorite hotel I've stayed at. Every corner has perfect details! There is a shuttle that will take you anywhere within a 3 mile radius  also they provide bikes that you could take into town. All the restaurants/shopping is basically walking distance. Definitely will come back!

findings.title: Ross R. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
The Pool and Lobby Area were very nice (which is the reason for the second star), my room situation was a different story.  For starters, upon checking in and booking on the website i was told that we would receive 2 free alcoholic beverages and to just charge them on the room. After reviewing my credit card statement, i was charged those on top of the room and never received a breakdown of charges during my Stay.  When i checked in, we put our stuff down in the room and headed out to dinner. After getting back from dinner we walk into our fully locked room to a knife being placed on a towel on the dresser, which was not there.  Thankfully they did move us to a new room.  The rooms appeared nice at a distance but upon close examination they were actually fairly dirty and the white fake leather head boards on the beds were peeling. Overall good location and nice pool and the lobby, but walking into a room after dinner to a knife, not receiving the free drinks as told, and the cleanliness of the room were all major turn offs to me.

PS consider turning the fire pits off in the lobby during the summer as it is well over 100 degrees outside already.

findings.title: M M. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
They lost another star for double charging me after I had pre-paid by booking through a third party. 
Trying to get a valid receipt has been a nightmare. Even the third party put me on hold to call them and said "the person who handles that is not there right now"- and this was during normal business hours. I've never had trouble using a booking site before, so it's unique to this hotel. Beware!

findings.title: Tracey C. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
This place is supposed to be 4 star- maybe 20 years ago. It's outdated, dingy, beat up, and stale smelling rooms leave a lot to be desired. Checking in we were given a second floor room over looking construction- ah no thanks. 
Moved to a first floor room near pool was better but windows dirty, beat up furniture and even ripped headboard. Eek. 
Service poolside- don't buy their drinks! Margarita was too sour to drink. How do you mess up a Moscow mule? By adding the same lime junk you put in the margarita- oh and where's the alcohol? Hmmm . I finally had to get them to remake me a drink - so pina colada- good lord- that was terrible too. And expensive resort prices for that stuff is not cool. 
Go somewhere else- we won't be back. If I could change for our last night and go elsewhere, I would. 
/

findings.title: Jordan K. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
DESIGN LOVERS PARADISE! This place was beautiful and looked exactly like their photos online! I can't say enough about the interiors and the attention to detail in terms of its design. 

Overall, the place was great and I'd absolutely stay again, but a few adjustments could be made, mainly with their bar/wait staff. The staff behind the front desk and the guys working the front door on the other hand, were all awesome! And, the free SHUTTLE SERVICE was a PLUS.

The food was actually really good...we at multiple times while we were there. From breakfast to food by the pool, and even dinner one evening in the outdoor area behind the bar, while old black and white movies played in the background. (Very nice touch.) Unfortunately for us, we kept kicking ourselves each time we did so bc the service was SO SLOW. The younger, male, dark haired bartender was also extremely unfriendly and rude. Took him at least 5 minutes the first time to even greet us when we approached the bar, and when we went back up for another cocktail later...even longer! Everyone else was very friendly, but EVERY TIME WE ORERED IT TOOK FOR.EV.VER. *Friendly tip to management- hire more staff. The restaurant was never busy, and poolside service should expect busy weekends and have staff to accommodate. Being friendly to patrons at the bar never hurts
a bartenders pockets either...*

(The only other complaint, and very minor, was the music player by the live DJ at the pool on Sunday. We were so excited to hear they live soon on weekends here...but the music was pretty specific to the minority crowd at the pool's taste that day. We heard several ppl make comments about the the psychedelic tunes being played.)

findings.title: L F. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Such a wonderful experience! Fabulous atmosphere. Must stop at the Cabana Club and hang w Rebecca the bartender - she's the absolute best!!

findings.title: Kerry C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This place is such a hidden gem. Love it. Every staff member is polite and friendly and accommodating. Better than "redone" hotels down the street or big chains.

findings.title: Lavi P. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Amazing spot for brunch and just a super chill place to hangout. The aesthetic of the place is amazing. All the rattan and brass accents/plants has me swooning. Definitely a favorite for staycations and summer nights.

findings.title: Charles C. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
My wife and I have been coming to this resort for years.  We have seen it go through 3 ownership changes and we are still currently in our room and not happy at all.  

To start with, the hotel is basically in a transition phase and it feels boarded up everywhere.  It should probably not even be open during this phase.  It is what it is though.

So we are told we are getting an "upgrade" which neither of us know entails but we said thank you and headed to our room which is #110.  When we walk in, we are surprised to see it opens into a suite with #108.  That's a nice touch.  My wife had to work so it was an element that helped.   She had planned to do some work and head to the pool while I was in the fitness center that had broken treadmills and towels laying around in a generally unkept look.

One note was the dead stink bug on the top of the bed that was just left there like a present.  I mean, come on!  That's disgusting.  

So yes, it gets better.  Instead of coming to door and explains that they made a "Big Mistake," they called and told my wife that they made a mistake and that the room #108 was not ours and it was supposed to be just #106.  Wait, #106 but we are in #110.  No explanation so maybe #106 was the fantastic upgrade?   They were rude and essentially told my wife that we need to get our stuff out asap because the guest coming in would be arriving at 6pm.  No "I'm sorry, can we help or can we give you something for the inconvenience."  Nothing but get out now.  

So my wife had to move everything out and now can't finish her work or enjoy the pool.  This is just really terrible customer service.  You are essentially treated like trash for a mistake that they made.  

Would you return to this hotel after that with there being so many other options in Scottsdale?

findings.title: Brytanee G. (4/5)
findings.snippet: The resort is absolutely stunning & exactly like the photos! All of the staff was extremely pleasant. We got spa treatments & afterwards spent the day at the pool.  We were told there were 2 pools; 1 for families & 1 for adults only however both pools had kids in there. It wasn't a huge deal but we were looking forward to less noise. The food & drinks were delicious. We can't wait to come back!

findings.title: Krystal M. (4/5)
